capabilities: Adds five custom heading tags: #d, #e, #t, #v and #c
Renders Evoldown headings in Reading view and Live Preview
Links an optional referenced title to a heading in the same note
Shows custom headings in the Outline with matching type icons
Sets the heading level (H1–H6) used for Evoldown entries
extras: Installed manually by extracting evoldown.zip into .obsidian/plugins; updating requires disabling and re-enabling the plugin. In exported PDFs, references are visual only and plugin navigation is unavailable.
problem: Obsidian's Markdown has no built-in way to mark structured note sections such as description, example, transfer and verification with their own headings, icons and cross-references.
summary: Adds Evoldown syntax to Obsidian, rendering five custom heading tags (#d, #e, #t, #v, #c) with titles and optional references.
